edition: World English Bible, 2020 stable text edition (eBible.org “eng-web”, Classic WEB). Uses “God” and “Yahweh”.

license.statement: The World English Bible is in the Public Domain. “World English Bible” is a trademark of eBible.org: if the text is changed, the result must not be called the World English Bible.

modifications: None to wording, so the name World English Bible is retained. USFM markup and Strong’s numbers removed; footnotes and cross-references moved to notes; words of Jesus (\wj) kept as styling.
